gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns confusing a tangential exact-differential integral with the normal derivative flux across a boundary. ISSUE-001 concerns an incorrect global representation of a single-layer potential by indicator functions and does not diagnose the flux integral or its normal-versus-tangential distinction.

Both identify the same sign error in the quadratic term of f_G: squaring z-conjugate z yields -4(Im z)^2, so the displayed plus sign gives the wrong real-part sign. The prediction also gives the corresponding sign correction.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The complex-layer formula and its one-line real-part calculation use the wrong sign for the quadratic term, making item (3) false until the non-analytic term is negated.

component_coverage.gold_component: The displayed quadratic term has the wrong sign because (z-conjugate z)^2=-4(Im z)^2, causing the real part of f_G to contradict the defining Green-function formula.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-002 explicitly performs the same square calculation and identifies the resulting opposite sign in the real part.

component_coverage.gold_component: The correction is to replace +(z-conjugate z)^2/(8b) by -(z-conjugate z)^2/(8b), with the calculation amended accordingly.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly proposes changing the sign of the non-analytic term and supplies the corrected formula.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue is a weighted-transpose error for the discrete matrices D_s and D, caused by nonuniform arc-length weights. ISSUE-001 concerns a false single-layer-potential representation on holes and does not address matrix adjoints, transpose identities, or quadrature weights.

The gold issue is double application of the product-quadrature weight in the singular block S_1^k and requires removing one w_j^k factor. ISSUE-001 concerns the domain representation of a single-layer potential and contains no diagnosis of quadrature weights or singular-block scaling.

The gold issue concerns omission of the +M term in the right-hand Steklov pencil and consequent loss of the constant-density zero mode. ISSUE-001 concerns an unrelated false equality for a single-layer potential and does not diagnose the modified Steklov operator, the constant subspace, or the generalized eigenproblem.
